etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English fifty, from Old English fīftiġ, from Proto-Germanic *fimf tigiwiz (“five tens”).

definitions.definition: (countable) A banknote or coin with a denomination of 50.

quote.text: ‘If you shoot him I’ll give you fifty pounds.’‘All right!’ The driver laughed. ‘I’ll do my best to earn that fifty!’

definitions.definition: (cricket) A batsman's score of at least 50 runs and less than 100 runs.
